verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for mid-morning — 11:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY, I’d do a camera check first before heading out, because Rey Cortiço mid-morning is the best option but the wind setup looks pretty off for that spot and Surfline consistency isn’t great. I’ll watch the Surfline cams and the MEO Beachcam for Rey Cortiço—if it’s not showing cleaner, more organized sets, I’m not bothering. There’s a low-rising tide, so the sandbanks might still line up briefly, but only commit if the cams look noticeably better than expected.
